name: Hikarie Hall

ops.catering: The hall arranges everything from placing the catering order through load-in and load-out and delivery (orders must be placed by 1 month before the day of use; minimum order amount from 126,000 yen; taking food home is not allowed). Bento boxes (each supplier has a minimum order amount), beverages by the case, and pot service (coffee, tea, cake) can also be arranged. Eating and drinking is allowed in the hall and foyers; simple cooking is allowed only in designated places (such as the bar counter in the foyer). (Source: catering page, FAQ, as of October 2026)
ops.restaurants: Shibuya Hikarie has 29 cafes and restaurants in total on the 6F, 7F, 8F and 11F (13 on 6F, 13 on 7F, 1 on 8F, 2 on 11F), and one each on B2, B1, 1F, 4F and 5F as well. The official page says they can be used for any occasion, such as welcome and farewell parties (6F 'dining6' offers cuisines from various countries; 7F 'TABLE7' is for all-day dining).
ops.prevDaySetup: If you wish to set up at night the day before, the setup start time is set according to instructions from the facility manager. Setup and teardown days apply for up to 2 days per event (Hall A 1,260,000 yen / Hall B 540,000 yen, each 10:00-22:00, excl. tax); from the 3rd day, the event-day rate applies. Outside hours (22:00 to 10:00 the next day) require prior approval, at 210,000 yen per hour for Hall A / 90,000 yen per hour for Hall B (excl. tax). (Source: Rules of Use PDF, October 2022 edition; fee schedule, May 2025 edition)
ops.waitingRooms: Hall A use: 1 organizer waiting room (9F, 45 m², included in the basic rental fee), 4 dressing rooms (10F, 41 / 42 / 19 / 25 m²), 1 dressing room office (8 m²). Hall B use: 2 organizer waiting rooms (9F, 43 / 17 m², included in the basic rental fee), 2 dressing rooms (10F, 30 / 19 m²), 1 dressing room office (13 m²). Dressing rooms cost 7,500-10,000 yen per day (excl. tax); dressing room offices are free when a 10F dressing room is used.
ops.loadingHours: The loading room on 1F (the entrance for delivery vehicles) accepts vehicles up to 11 t; berth opening W4,000 mm (depth W3,500 mm), platform height 1,000 mm. The large load-in and load-out elevator is W8,000 x D3,000 x H4,500 mm (opening H3,400 mm), maximum load 10,000 kg (plus 2 small elevators, 1,600 kg). The loading room and elevators are shared with other facilities in the building and can be used exclusively only during the requested time slot. The usage hours (10:00-22:00) include setup and teardown time; a meeting with the facility manager on the schedule, setup, etc. is held by 30 days before the start of use, and load-in and load-out are discussed in advance with the facility manager and carried out with the facility manager present. (Source: FAQ, facility page, Rules of Use PDF October 2022 edition)
ops.parking: When using the hall, use the Shibuya Hikarie parking lot or a nearby coin parking lot. The Hikarie parking lot is mechanical, open 6:50-24:00 (last entry 23:30), 400 yen per 30 min (tax included), maximum charge 3,200 yen (weekdays during business hours only). Vehicle size limits for entry: standard cars L5,300 x W1,900 x H1,550 mm, weight 2,300 kg; high-roof vehicles up to a height of 2,000 mm. Use of Hikarie Hall is not eligible for the parking discount service, and there is no parking for group buses.
ops.vehicleRules: Load-in and load-out must use the designated entrance, and street parking or illegal parking on surrounding roads is not allowed. Load-in and load-out are discussed in advance with the facility manager and carried out with the facility manager present. Depending on events at other facilities in the building, the use of the parking lot and the load-in and load-out elevator may be adjusted. Do not wait on public roads when the building parking lot is full. (Source: Rules of Use PDF October 2022 edition, access page)
